scope: Actual Redis detailed task-lock causes, cancellation, cleanup and fencing; no Python exception inference
checks: Cancelled SET and release retain caller and one lease budget through actual reply and cleanup.
SET ACL error preserves NOPERM while cleanup settles with one command slot; legacy maps RedisUnavailable.
Release wrong-type retains separate WRONGTYPE code/detail and never deletes replacement owner.
limitations: Source-specific endpoint-dependent network arguments, initialization failures, arbitrary SQL exceptions and truthful traceback formatting are separate gates.
Raw release command error may have remote side effects; I/O reply loss must remain ambiguous to a future writer.
Source140 wrong-type code/detail assertion failure retained.
